ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels represent approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the trailing edges, distal tips, and central midline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The central lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white regions. High-contrast black pigmentation forms a jagged border along the entire trailing edge. Notable focal dark blobs include a circular cluster in the upper right quadrant and a horizontal linear mark in the mid-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of ~0.12 relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary of both lobes. A prominent, low-frequency deep indentation is visible on the inner margin of the right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep trajectory directed from the tips toward the median notch, while leading edges (partially submerged) show a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a single localized circular high-contrast dark cluster in the upper-right quadrant of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal linear disruption (rake mark) located in the center of the right lobe; multiple vertical linear streaks are detected near the distal edge of the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear scar on the right lobe surface and an irregular traumatic indentation on the inner right trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical column of pigmentation extending from the base of the median notch toward the peduncle.
